name: @autobroker/harness
description: AutoBroker live-LLM harness — the runnable implementation of the harness-standard (runner CLI, case TOML, 6+1 anchor evaluator, verdict.json, Approver gate poller, isolation preflight, test_run_records daily export). Black-box-drives the SUT over HTTP/SSE (api lane) or through the REAL built dashboard DOM (ui lane — uiDriver.ts is the one sanctioned playwright import: the TEST browser, never the product's browser service); reads the product DB READ-ONLY through @autobroker/db (the only permitted S3 channel); NEVER writes the DB (one sanctioned, narrowly-scoped exception: harness/seed.ts writes pending dealer_inventory_sources case-seed rows into the ISOLATED run DB through the @autobroker/tools seeder, before the consuming inventory_link_scan step) and NEVER calls a provider directly (the SUT owns every side effect). dependency-cruiser isolates the rest of this package from better-sqlite3/drizzle-orm/playwright/@ai-sdk — respect that wall.
